# EBSCO

> > EBSCO provides research databases, discovery services, and digital content solutions for libraries, institutions, and healthcare organizations worldwide.

EBSCO offers comprehensive access to peer-reviewed research through platforms like EBSCOhost, specialized clinical tools like DynaMed, and premium databases including Academic Search Ultimate and Business Source Ultimate. The company serves academic libraries, medical institutions, and corporate organizations with discovery services, e-books, and e-journals.

## Key Topics

- EBSCOhost
- DynaMed
- Academic Search Ultimate
- Business Source Ultimate
- research databases
- discovery service
- peer-reviewed research
- library services
- institutional access
- e-books
- academic resources
- healthcare information
- full-text databases
